items.title: 比特幣為何突然暴漲？能否突破8萬美元需觀察這「三項指標」
paras: 比特幣沉寂數月後突然迎來強勁反彈，價格一度升至79,455美元，創下約3個月新高，本週累計漲幅超過20%。包括以太幣（ETH）、瑞波幣（XRP）、Solana（SOL）等主要加密貨幣，以及多檔加密貨幣概念股也同步走強。
分析指出，這波行情並非單一消息所推動。美國財政部宣布擴大長天期美國公債回購規模，成為市場情緒轉折的重要催化劑；美元走弱及利率政策預期變化，也提供比特幣上漲的宏觀環境。
另一方面，市場原本高度集中的比特幣空頭部位遭到大規模清算，進一步放大漲勢，隨後美國現貨比特幣ETF資金流入回升，則為市場帶來新的現貨需求。
不過，這波反彈能否進一步發展成為持續性行情，市場仍有不同看法。
部分分析認為，空頭回補只是推動行情加速的力量，ETF資金與現貨買盤若能持續進場，可能讓漲勢延續；另一派則提醒，美國財政部回購操作並未解決美國債務與通膨問題，等空頭強制平倉告一段落後，比特幣仍須面對新增資金及聯準會政策的考驗。

美財政部擴大美債回購 比特幣迎來轉折

美國財政部近期宣布，將提高長天期美債回購操作規模，成為這波比特幣行情的重要導火線。
根據《路透》報導，美國財政部計畫將10至20年期，以及20至30年期長天期名目附息國債的流動性支持回購操作最高規模，由每次20億美元提高至「不低於40億美元」。相關調整將於9月9日至11月4日實施。
這代表，目前市場反映的主要是投資人對政策公告的解讀，並非新增規模的回購操作已經全面執行。美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）隨後也表示，實際回購規模仍可能進一步擴大。
根據美國財政部，調整主要是為長天期美債提供更大的流動性支持。美國自2024年恢復國債回購機制後，相關操作主要用於改善流動性較低的舊券交易，同時進行現金管理。
但此次政策宣布的時間點相當敏感。長天期美債當時正面臨拋售壓力，殖利率快速上升，因此部分投資人將此舉解讀為美國政府開始更加積極地介入債市，以減輕長端殖利率上行壓力。
消息公布後，長天期美債殖利率一度回落，美元同步走弱，黃金及比特幣則雙雙上漲，「貨幣貶值交易」重新受到市場關注。
換言之，市場關注的可能不只是每次40億美元的回購金額，而是財政部釋放出的政策訊號。
美國公共債務已突破40兆美元，30年期美債殖利率近期更一度升至2007年以來最高水準。在這種背景下，如果美國政府不希望長期融資成本持續上升，市場開始預期，未來可能看到更多債券回購或調整債務發行期限等措施。
《路透》引述豐業銀行首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne指出，財政壓力並不會因此消失，最終代價可能以更高的美債殖利率呈現，或轉由美元承擔。
德意志銀行策略師George Saravelos則將債券回購，以及鼓勵海外央行使用聯準會回購工具等措施，形容為一種「軟性金融壓抑」，也就是利用政策手段限制長天期殖利率進一步上升。
對市場而言，美元走弱、主權債務風險升高，加上政府對債市的政策介入，都強化黃金及比特幣等稀缺資產的配置論述。

利率預期改變 比特幣獲得宏觀支撐

美國財政部的回購公告並非這波行情唯一的宏觀因素。
在此之前，美國通膨數據已逐漸趨於溫和，就業市場也開始出現疲軟跡象，使投資人重新評估聯準會進一步收緊貨幣政策的可能性。
CoinShares研究主管James Butterfill在近日發布的報告中指出，比特幣這一輪上漲首先是一場「宏觀行情」，而不是單純由加密貨幣市場內部因素所推動。
雖然聯準會會議紀要顯示，官員對通膨及貨幣政策的討論仍比最終政策決定更加偏向鷹派，但後續公布的溫和通膨及疲弱就業數據，持續削弱進一步收緊政策的理由。
CoinShares指出，短期美債殖利率下滑，反映債市對聯準會進一步升息的預期減弱；但另一方面，長天期殖利率仍受到財政赤字、債務發行及美國財政永續性疑慮支撐。
在這種「貨幣政策預期轉向寬鬆」與「主權債務永續性受到質疑」同時出現的環境下，比特幣可能獲得相對有利的宏觀條件。一方面，流動性壓力減輕；另一方面，比特幣作為非主權、去中心化資產的配置論述也受到強化。
不過，市場對未來利率路徑仍沒有形成一致看法。最新期貨定價仍反映投資人對今年升息保留相當高的可能性，代表目前支撐比特幣的宏觀環境仍可能改變。

空頭集中遭清算 暴漲被進一步放大

分析稱，宏觀環境轉變可以解釋比特幣為何開始上漲，但並不足以完全說明價格為何能在短時間內大幅攀升。
真正讓行情加速的關鍵，在於加密貨幣衍生品市場出現大規模「空頭擠壓」。
在這波反彈之前，比特幣長時間處於成交量及波動率偏低的環境，市場部位也明顯偏向防禦及做空。當財政部公告刺激價格突破重要阻力位及200日移動平均線後，大量空頭部位開始被迫平倉。
空頭平倉代表交易員必須買進比特幣回補部位，因此形成「價格上漲、空頭被迫買入、價格進一步上漲、更多空頭遭清算」的連鎖反應。
據《Investor's Business Daily》引述CoinGlass數據，自8月19日以來，整體加密市場累計已有超過43億美元空頭部位遭到清算。
《彭博》則報導，僅8月19日一天，整體加密市場就有約27億美元空頭部位被清算，創CoinGlass自2021年開始統計以來最高紀錄；其中，比特幣空頭在約一小時內遭清算的金額就超過10億美元。
CoinShares則將這次空頭擠壓形容為有紀錄以來規模最大的一次，但並未公布具體清算金額。因此，上述43億美元、27億美元及比特幣1小時超過10億美元，分別代表不同期間與統計範圍，不能直接視為同一口徑。
部分分析認為，衍生品市場的被動買盤可能在本輪上漲中扮演過大的角色。
CryptoQuant分析師BorisD指出，幣安平台的空頭擠壓指標已升至2024年11月以來最高水準，顯示期貨市場的被動買盤是此次行情的重要推力。如果現貨交易量、機構資金及鏈上資金流入無法繼續承接價格上漲後的賣壓，市場可能面臨回檔。
MEXC Research首席分析師Shawn Young表示，加密市場可能對財政部介入債市的實際影響給予了過高的定價。從這個角度來看，財政部公告更像是打開一道「壓力閥」，促使高度擁擠的空頭部位快速撤出，而非立即改變比特幣的宏觀基本面。
Zeus Research分析師Dominick John也指出，空頭清算短期仍可能推升價格，但同時也會消耗重要的被動買盤來源。當大量空頭完成平倉後，市場就必須依靠真正的現貨需求、流動性及宏觀基本面延續漲勢。
因此，空頭擠壓雖然是本輪暴漲的重要因素，但只能提供階段性的買盤。強平潮退去後，市場是否還有足夠的新增資金進場，將成為下一階段的關鍵。

比特幣ETF連續吸金 機構需求開始回升

若只把這波行情視為空頭回補所造成的反彈，也可能低估現貨市場的變化。ETF資金流向顯示，機構現貨需求近期也開始回升。
SoSoValue數據顯示，美國現貨比特幣ETF在8月17日至20日連續4個交易日錄得淨流入，累計金額約16億美元。其中，8月20日單日淨流入約6.06億美元。
另一方面，CoinShares以全球數位資產投資產品（ETP）計算，截至8月20日報告發布時，本週資金流入約22億美元，創2026年以來最高水準，其中比特幣投資產品約占16億美元，也推動比特幣年內累計資金流重新轉為正值。
兩組數據的統計範圍並不相同，前者僅涵蓋美國現貨比特幣ETF，後者則包含全球不同類型的數位資產投資產品，因此不能直接相加或視為同一組數據。
不過，兩項數據共同反映出一項重要變化：機構資金正在重新回到市場。
STS Digital共同創辦人兼董事長Gideon Hyams表示，空頭擠壓可以啟動一波行情，卻無法單獨維持長期趨勢。這次反彈除了空頭回補外，也受到長天期殖利率變化、ETF資金回流及美國加密貨幣監管方向逐漸明確等因素支持。
Nansen高級研究分析師Nicolai Søndergaard則認為，空頭回補加速了突破，但並非這波行情唯一的來源。比特幣技術結構已經改善，現貨及ETF需求也有所增強。
但隨著空頭逐漸出清、槓桿多頭部位開始變得擁擠，比特幣能否守住關鍵價位，最終仍要看現貨買盤是否能持續。

巨鯨停止拋售 技術面也出現改善

除了ETF資金之外，比特幣市場內部結構近期也出現一些正面變化。
CoinShares指出，先前持續賣出比特幣的巨鯨近期已停止減持，並開始重新累積。雖然目前的累積規模還不足以證明比特幣將立即展開持續突破，但賣方壓力減輕仍為價格提供一定支撐。
與此同時，比特幣重新站上200日移動平均線。這項指標通常被市場用來判斷中長期趨勢，價格由下向上突破後，也可能吸引趨勢型交易者及量化策略進一步買入。
VanEck在8月18日發布的鏈上報告則指出，截至當時統計時間，美國現貨比特幣ETP過去30天淨流入約6.63億美元，扭轉前一個月約24億美元淨流出的局面。
不過，VanEck報告中的多數數據截至8月11日或12日，因此主要反映本輪暴漲正式啟動前的市場結構。
報告指出，截至8月11日的前30天內，持有比特幣超過1年的BTC供應量淨減少約35.6萬枚，長期持有者持有的供應占比降至59.1%。
VanEck將此視為潛在的長期持有者分發訊號，但同時也提出，近期部分錢包安全事件可能促使持有者基於預防目的轉移資產。
不過，VanEck強調，這項解釋目前仍無法獲得驗證，而且相關安全事件涉及的BTC數量遠低於長期供應變動，因此不能據此認定供應變化主要源自錢包轉移，也不能直接判斷這些BTC已全部進入市場出售。

美國監管進展也推升市場風險偏好

除了宏觀環境、ETF資金與空頭清算，美國近期加密貨幣監管政策的發展，也進一步改善市場情緒。
美國總統川普近日再次呼籲國會通過「公平版本」的《CLARITY Act》，美國商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）也準備推動加密貨幣市場結構相關規則。
市場認為，更明確的監管框架有助於降低銀行、資產管理公司等傳統金融機構配置數位資產時面臨的法律及合規不確定性。
根據《Dow Jones Newswires》報導，Zaye Capital Markets分析師Naeem Aslam認為，本輪上漲受到監管進展、機構現貨需求、殖利率下滑預期以及空頭回補等多重因素推動。
不過，CoinShares認為，《CLARITY Act》等監管進展對以太幣、Solana及其他山寨幣的直接影響可能更加明顯。
就比特幣而言，本輪行情主要驅動因素仍集中在利率、美元、財政風險、空頭部位及資金流向，監管利多主要扮演情緒推動角色。

美債回購並非沒有副作用

需要注意的是，雖然美國財政部擴大美債回購在短期內有利於比特幣，但這項政策對風險資產的長期影響未必完全正面。
CoinShares指出，財政部回購舊有長天期債券所需的資金仍需要透過發行新債籌措，因此並沒有真正解決財政赤字及債務增加問題。
如果美國政府進一步轉向短期融資，政府債務的平均期限可能縮短，使財政利息支出對聯準會短期利率更加敏感。
政策本身也存在潛在矛盾。長天期殖利率維持高檔原本具有收緊金融條件的效果；如果財政部主動壓低長天期殖利率，金融環境可能重新轉向寬鬆，進而增加通膨壓力，迫使聯準會更長時間維持高利率，甚至重新升息。
此外，美元走弱也可能推高進口成本與通膨，進一步限制聯準會放鬆貨幣政策的空間。
Bannockburn Global Forex首席市場策略師Marc Chandler表示，貝森特試圖壓低殖利率的措施，目前並沒有真正壓低美債殖利率，反而削弱了美元，顯示市場正在對政策進行反應。
CIBC Capital Markets外匯策略主管Sarah Ying則指出，如果財政部過度放鬆金融環境，可能重新推升通膨，迫使聯準會採取更鷹派的政策。

比特幣能否突破8萬美元？市場等待下一個訊號

分析人士認為，綜合目前市場變化，這輪比特幣上漲大致可以拆解成三個階段：

首先是宏觀與財政政策變化提供上漲理由；
其次是價格突破技術關卡後，引發大規模空頭清算；
最後則是ETF與現貨資金進場，決定這場逼空行情能否進一步轉化為持續趨勢。


短期而言，8萬美元仍是市場高度關注的關卡。
CoinShares認為，比特幣目前仍可能維持區間震盪，8萬美元附近構成重要上方壓力。若要形成更明確的突破，則需要聯準會釋放更清楚的政策訊號，確認貨幣政策進一步收緊的風險已明顯下降。
接下來的Jackson Hole全球央行年會，將成為市場觀察焦點。投資人將密切留意聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）對通膨、就業及未來利率路徑的看法。
如果華許釋放偏鴿訊號，或未能消除市場對美元及美國財政可信度的疑慮，比特幣可能繼續受惠；反之，若他再次強調通膨風險並釋放進一步緊縮的訊號，目前的宏觀利多可能迅速逆轉。
《路透》報導指出，當時聯邦基金期貨交易員預估，聯準會9月升息機率約40%，截至12月升息的機率則約72%。不過，由於期貨價格會隨市場變化即時調整，相關數據僅反映Reuters報導當時的市場預期。
TD Securities分析師指出，如果華許在Jackson Hole會議上強調通膨可信度，對美元的支撐作用可能有限；但若未能充分回應通膨問題，美元則可能面臨更明顯的下行壓力。
這也代表，Jackson Hole會議可能透過美元及利率預期，對比特幣帶來雙向影響。
根據分析人士，從市場結構來看，後續有三項指標值得關注。
首先是美國現貨比特幣ETF能否延續淨流入。 隨著空頭部位逐步清算，被迫買盤將逐漸減少，市場必須依靠真正的新增資金維持漲勢。
其次是比特幣能否守住突破區域。Søndergaard指出，只要比特幣持續站穩7萬美元上方，技術面仍維持正面格局；即使回落至6萬9,000至6萬9,700美元附近，也可能被視為正常的突破回測，而不必然代表趨勢反轉。
第三則是美元與長天期美債殖利率走勢。 如果美元持續走弱，市場對美國財政永續性及貨幣貶值的疑慮延續，比特幣的非主權資產論述可能繼續受到支撐；但如果長天期殖利率重新走高，或通膨壓力迫使聯準會轉向更鷹派，比特幣及其他風險資產的壓力也可能增加。
整體而言，這波比特幣大漲還不足以直接被定義為新一輪長期牛市。美國財政部擴大美債回購是行情的導火線，空頭擠壓則大幅放大漲幅，而ETF與現貨資金流入則提供了初步的持續性訊號。
隨著大量空頭已經完成平倉，這項重要的被動買盤來源正在逐漸減少。接下來，比特幣能否維持強勢，將取決於ETF資金、現貨交易及宏觀政策能否繼續提供支撐。

items.title: 中國人形機器人出貨量稱霸全球！智元市占43.1%居冠、前5名全是中國業者
paras: 全球人形機器人產業持續快速擴張，中國企業在出貨規模上的領先優勢也進一步浮現。Counterpoint Research數據顯示，2026年上半年全球人形機器人出貨量年增近300%，其中中國企業包辦全球出貨量前5名，智元機器人更以約9700台的出貨量排名第一，市占率達43.1%，顯示中國業者正從技術展示階段，快速走向規模化商業應用。
從市場排名來看，宇樹科技以31.1%的市占率排名第二，與第一名智元共同占據全球逾7成市場；其後依序為銀河通用、優必選(09880-HK) 與樂聚機器人，市占率分別為5%、4.4%及2.9%。其餘包括海外品牌在內的其他業者，合計市占率僅13.4%。
人形機器人的主要成本集中在伺服馬達、減速器、力控關節、3D視覺及動力電池等零組件，與新能源車產業存在一定程度的供應鏈相似性。
中國企業在相關零組件與製造體系具備一定產業基礎，也成為當地人形機器人業者推進量產的重要條件。
從各家產品布局來看，中國人形機器人市場並非單純依靠少數產品大量出貨，而是逐漸形成不同企業切入不同應用場景的格局。
智元機器人目前主要布局「遠征」、「精靈」與「靈犀」三大產品線。其中，遠征聚焦政企及商業應用；精靈主要面向消費電子、汽車零組件等工業場景；靈犀則涵蓋文娛商演、科研教育及資料採集等用途，產品布局相對多元。
宇樹科技則在科研與教育領域具有較強布局，其G1人形機器人在教育市場的市占率約31%。此外，宇樹也持續推進高階人形機器人產品，並與輝達(NVDA-US) 合作，基於輝達Isaac GR00T平台開發H2 Plus，主要鎖定科研教育市場。
相較之下，銀河通用主要聚焦醫藥與工業應用，2026年上半年人形機器人出貨量超過1100台。該公司推出的Galbot S1輪式雙臂機器人，已完成寧德時代(03750-HK) 產線驗收，並搭載寧德時代電池，用於電池生產相關工作。
優必選上半年出貨量同樣達到千台級，主要切入汽車與消費電子等製造場景，同時透過「優世界」品牌布局情感陪伴、教育娛樂等家庭應用。
樂聚機器人上半年出貨量則約650台，主要產品為夸父系列，搭載開源鴻蒙系統，應用於人形機器人資料訓練中心及部分工業製造場景。

從展示走向實際應用　中國業者加速擴大部署

Counterpoint Research進一步指出，2026年上半年全球人形機器人應用中，文娛商演與科研資料採集占比最高，分別達33.6%及27%；其次為導覽導購，占19%，智慧製造與倉儲物流則分別占12.8%及4.9%。
值得注意的是，目前占比最高的兩大應用領域，正是中國人形機器人業者積極布局的市場。
從商業演出、演唱會到大型活動，中國人形機器人的實際部署持續增加；另一方面，科研教育市場則由宇樹科技等業者推動產品普及。這些應用除了帶動機器人出貨，也為業者提供更多實際運作與資料採集場景。
在人形機器人產業仍處於快速發展階段的情況下，實際部署數量增加代表企業能取得更多真實環境中的訓練資料，並進一步用於改善機器人的控制與作業能力。

中國人形機器人產業進入規模競爭階段

分析指出，從特斯拉(TSLA-US) Optimus、波士頓動力Atlas等產品來看，海外企業在人形機器人技術上仍具有代表性產品，並在產業發展過程中扮演重要角色。不過，從出貨量來看，中國企業目前已展現明顯的規模化優勢。
近期日本日經xTECH曾發布日本技術人員拆解宇樹G1人形機器人的影片，日本團隊對G1的內部設計及零組件工藝給予高度評價，並認為中國機器人產業已不再只是展示技術。
目前中國人形機器人業者一方面持續擴大出貨規模，另一方面也依據工業製造、科研教育、商演娛樂及資料採集等不同需求進行產品分工。對於仍在快速成長的人形機器人產業而言，量產能力、應用場景與資料累積，正逐漸成為企業競爭的重要因素。

items.title: 高盛：市場瀰漫著「停滯性通貨膨脹」的味道！貝森特出手仍難敵油價與消費疲軟雙重夾擊
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs: Market Smells of "Stagnant Inflation"! Bessent's Moves Still Can't Overcome Dual Hit from Oil Prices and Weak Consumer Spending
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）近期頻頻釋放政策訊號，試圖透過美國國債回購、財政整合等措施壓低長天期美債殖利率，但市場反應似乎並不買單。10年期與30年期美債殖利率短暫走低後迅速反彈，與此同時，油價單週大漲逾7%、黃金上漲約3.5%，美元走弱，消費數據也開始出現降溫跡象。多項資產同步出現異動，使市場重新聚焦「停滯性通貨膨脹」風險。
高盛單一Delta交易台主管Rich Privorotsky直言，目前跨資產市場已經「瀰漫著停滯性通貨膨脹的味道」。
他認為，雖然貝森特手中的政策「工具箱」龐大，但要同時應對長端利率、財政赤字、能源價格和消費疲軟，難度正在上升。

貝森特頻出手 長債殖利率仍難以下降

貝森特週四表示，美國財政部每期國債回購規模可以超過40億美元，並將相關操作形容為「國債扭轉操作」，同時強調財政部擁有「龐大的工具箱」。
然而，市場並未出現持續性的正面反應。在長天期國債回購、日美聯合干預日元，以及財政部釋放可能進一步採取措施的訊號後，10年期美債殖利率仍回升至約4.7%，30年期則升至約5.25%。
Privorotsky認為，與長天期殖利率能否持續下滑相比，美元走弱可能是目前更值得關注的市場訊號。
美國目前一方面面臨龐大的國債發行壓力，另一方面，人工智慧（AI）與資料中心建設仍持續吸收大量資本。在政府融資需求與企業融資需求同步增加的情況下，僅依靠財政部回購操作，恐怕難以從根本上改變長天期債券市場的供需結構。
財政整合同樣面臨市場質疑。貝森特先前提出透過「反詐欺工作組」等機制削減數千億美元支出，但Privorotsky認為，相關政策最終能否落實仍存在高度不確定性，因此市場很難僅憑政策承諾，就大幅調整對美國長期財政狀況的預期。

油價大漲 消費卻開始降溫

除了債市之外，近期油價快速上漲也進一步加深市場對停滯性通貨膨脹的擔憂。更值得注意的是，能源成本上升與消費活動降溫正同時出現。
沃爾瑪最新數據顯示，美國同店銷售成長率僅2.6%，創下6年來最低水準；客流量成長率也從前一季的3%降至1.5%。
雖然管沃爾瑪仍上調全年業績指引，但公司管理層警告，若油價升至每加侖4美元以上，消費者可能開始調整支出並在不同商品之間做出取捨。
Privorotsky將目前的美國經濟形容為「啞鈴型」結構：一端是AI與資料中心持續吸收大量資本，另一端則是消費活動開始承受壓力。
跨資產市場的表現也呈現類似訊號，包括油價上漲、黃金走強及美元走弱，而長天期美債殖利率仍維持高檔。
此外，黃金與銅的比值走高，美國10年期損益平衡通膨率在過去兩週上升近10個基點，「停滯性通貨膨脹籃子」本週累計上漲6.7%。
分析指出，這些變化顯示市場目前交易的已不只是單一資產價格波動，而是對停滯性通貨膨脹情境的重新定價。

殖利率、通膨與消費 美聯準會陷兩難

接下來， Jackson Hole央行年會將成為市場關注焦點。Privorotsky認為，無論聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）釋放偏鴿或偏鷹的政策訊號，都可能讓市場陷入兩難。
若政策訊號偏鴿，可能推升長天期殖利率與通膨預期；若訊號偏鷹，則可能進一步壓抑已經開始降溫的消費活動。
在通膨壓力尚未完全消退、經濟成長卻開始承受壓力的情況下，美國貨幣政策面臨的取捨也更加複雜。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has been sending frequent policy signals lately, trying to lower long-term Treasury yields through bond buybacks and fiscal consolidation, but the market has not seemed to buy in. After a brief dip, 10‑year and 30‑year Treasury yields quickly rebounded, while oil jumped more than 7% in a week, gold rose about 3.5%, the dollar weakened and consumer data began to cool, causing a simultaneous shift across several assets and refocusing the market on the risk of "stagnant inflation".
Goldman Sachs Delta desk head Rich Privorotsky bluntly said that a "stagnant inflation" vibe now permeates cross‑asset markets.
He believes that although Bessent has a huge policy "toolbox," tackling long‑end rates, fiscal deficits, energy prices and weak consumption all at once is becoming increasingly difficult.

Bessent’s Frequent Moves Yet Long‑Bond Yields Remain Stubborn Bessent said on Thursday that the Treasury can conduct bond buybacks of over $40 billion per tranche, calling the operation a "bond reversal" and emphasizing the Treasury’s "massive toolbox".

However, the market has not given a sustained positive reaction. After long‑term bond buybacks, a joint U.S.–Japan yen‑intervention and signals that the Treasury may take further steps, the 10‑year yield rose back to about 4.7% and the 30‑year to roughly 5.25%.
Privorotsky thinks that, compared with whether long‑term yields can keep falling, a weakening dollar may be the more noteworthy market signal right now.

The U.S. faces huge Treasury issuance pressure while AI and data‑center construction continue to soak up massive capital. With government and corporate financing needs rising together, Treasury buybacks alone are unlikely to fundamentally change the supply‑demand balance in the long‑bond market.

Fiscal consolidation also meets market scepticism. Bessent previously proposed cutting hundreds of billions of dollars in spending via mechanisms such as an "anti‑fraud working group," but Privorotsky says the ultimate implementation of those policies remains highly uncertain, making it hard for the market to substantially revise expectations for the U.S.’s long‑term fiscal outlook based solely on policy promises.

Oil Prices Surge While Consumption Cools Beyond the bond market, the recent rapid rise in oil prices has deepened worries about stagnant inflation. Notably, higher energy costs and cooling consumer activity are occurring simultaneously.
Walmart’s latest data show same‑store sales growth of just 2.6%, the lowest in six years, and foot‑traffic growth falling from 3% in the prior quarter to 1.5%.
Although Walmart still raised its full‑year outlook, management warned that if oil climbs above $4 per gallon, consumers may start adjusting spending and making trade‑offs across product categories.
Privorotsky describes the current U.S. economy as a "dumbbell" structure: one end is AI and data‑center investment soaking up capital, the other end is consumer activity beginning to feel pressure.
Cross‑asset markets are sending similar signals, with oil up, gold strong and the dollar weak, while long‑term Treasury yields stay elevated.

In addition, the gold‑to‑copper ratio has risen, the 10‑year breakeven inflation rate in the U.S. has climbed nearly 10 basis points over the past two weeks, and the "stagnant inflation basket" has risen 6.7% this week.
Analysts say these moves show the market is now pricing not just single‑asset price swings but a broader re‑valuation of a stagnant‑inflation scenario.

Yield, Inflation and Consumption – The Fed in a Bind The upcoming Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium will be a market focus. Privorotsky believes that whether Fed Chair Kevin Warsh signals a dovish or hawkish stance could trap the market in a dilemma.
If signals are dovish, they could push up long‑term yields and inflation expectations; if hawkish, they could further suppress consumption that is already beginning to cool.
With inflation pressures not fully gone and economic growth starting to feel strain, the trade‑offs facing U.S. monetary policy become even more complex.

items.title: 七年來首次！阿里巴巴擬配售800億港元新股 全部投入AI建設
items.title_en: First Time in Seven Years! Alibaba Plans HK$80 Billion New Share Placement, All Invested in AI Infrastructure
paras: 阿里巴巴(09988-HK) (BABA-US) 宣布港股上市以來首次配售新股，募資800億港元，全部用於人工智慧（AI）基礎設施。
阿里巴巴23日（周日）宣布擬向美國境外非美國人士配售新股，配售總金額800億港元。這也是阿里巴巴2019年港股上市以來首次啟動新股配售。
據《華爾街見聞》報導，本次配售所得款項淨額將100%用於投資全棧AI能力，加強AI基礎設施建設，進一步鞏固阿里在AI領域的全球領先地位。
AI正在成為驅動阿里加速增長的核心引擎，8月20日阿里發布的最新財報顯示，阿里巴巴AI相關產品年化收入（ARR）已突破495億元人民幣（73億美元），預計下季度達到100億美元。
此次配股，本質上是為阿里巴巴已經啟動的大規模資本支出計畫補充彈藥。
首席財務長徐宏在電話會上解釋了這一邏輯：「必須是capex先行，才能獲得後面的業務增長。」無論是AI軟體訂閱、大模型API推理還是GPU租用，商業化都建立在算力中心等基礎設施之上。
阿里巴巴於2025年2月公布了三年3,800億元人民幣的投資計畫。截至2026年6月季度末，阿里巴巴累計已經投入約1,900億元，整體進度符合預期。
在投資回報方面，阿里巴巴執行長吳泳銘表示，AI算力資產目前預計約三年回收成本，隨著AI相關產品毛利率持續提升，回收周期有望進一步縮短至約2.5年，「甚至兩年左右」。
徐宏援引實際運營數據稱，阿里巴巴2018年採購的V100和2020年採購的A100目前仍接近滿載運行，顯示AI算力資產的實際使用壽命明顯長於理論折舊周期——這意味三年回本之後，資產仍可持續貢獻正向自由現金流。
paras_en: Alibaba (09988-HK) (BABA-US) announced its first new‑share placement since its Hong Kong listing, raising HK$80 billion, with the entire proceeds earmarked for artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure.

On Sunday the 23rd, Alibaba said it intends to place new shares to non‑U.S. persons outside the United States, with a total placement amount of HK$80 billion. This is also the first share placement Alibaba has launched since its Hong Kong IPO in 2019.

According to Wall Street Journal’s Chinese edition, the net proceeds from this placement will be 100% used to invest in full‑stack AI capabilities, strengthen AI infrastructure construction, and further cement Alibaba’s global leadership in AI.

AI is becoming the core engine driving Alibaba’s accelerated growth; the latest financial results released on August 20 show that Alibaba’s AI‑related products generated an annualised recurring revenue (ARR) of RMB 49.5 billion (US$7.3 billion), with the figure expected to reach US$10 billion next quarter.
This share issuance essentially serves as ammunition to supplement Alibaba’s already‑launched large‑scale capital‑expenditure programme.

Chief Financial Officer Xu Hong explained the logic in a conference call: “Capex must come first in order to generate subsequent business growth.” Whether it is AI software subscriptions, large‑model API inference, or GPU leasing, commercialization is built on infrastructure such as compute‑power centres.

Alibaba announced a three‑year RMB 380 billion investment plan in February 2025. By the end of the June 2026 quarter, Alibaba had cumulatively invested about RMB 190 billion, with overall progress on track with expectations.

Regarding investment returns, CEO Wu Yongming said AI compute assets are currently projected to recoup costs in roughly three years, and as AI product gross margins continue to improve, the pay‑back period could further shrink to about 2.5 years, “even around two years.”

Xu Hong cited operational data showing that Alibaba’s V100 GPUs purchased in 2018 and A100 GPUs bought in 2020 are still running near full capacity, indicating that the actual service life of AI compute assets far exceeds the theoretical depreciation schedule—meaning that after the three‑year pay‑back, the assets can continue to generate positive free cash flow.

items.title: 輝達AI伺服器明年恐漲逾15%！記憶體成關鍵成本：DRAM飆64%、HBM溢價超300%
items.title_en: Nvidia AI Server Prices May Jump Over 15% Next Year as Memory Becomes Key Cost Driver: DRAM Up 64%, HBM Premium Over 300%
paras: 隨著記憶體晶片成本飆升，輝達(NVDA-US) 部分大型客戶已獲告知，稱搭載輝達人工智慧（AI）晶片的伺服器價格在許多情況下將上漲超過15%。
根據《彭博》報導，知情人士透露，這波漲價預計適用於明年初出貨的系統，包括搭載輝達最新Vera Rubin，以及Grace Blackwell晶片的伺服器。他們表示，實際漲幅將取決於輝達晶片的世代以及記憶體配置。
專家分析指出，《彭博》之所以點名Vera Rubin以及Grace Blackwell是因為兩者共同反映出AI運算對記憶體與儲存資源的需求持續攀升。
Grace Blackwell平台已展現對HBM與DDR5等高效能記憶體的高度需求。隨著相關元件成本增加，輝達先前已提高H200、B200晶片及模組價格，伺服器製造商也同步調整報價，漲幅約達10%至15%。
至於下一代Vera Rubin平台，其記憶體配置預計將更加積極。三星電子(005930KS) 已宣布，旗下企業級SSD PM1763將針對輝達Vera Rubin平台提供支援，其連續讀寫速度較前一代產品提升一倍。
更值得注意的是，記憶體配置正逐漸成為AI伺服器價格的重要變數。即使採用相同世代的AI晶片，不同記憶體容量與配置方案也可能造成顯著的成本差異。
知情人士表示，近期負責為微軟(MSFT-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下Google及甲骨文(ORCL-US) 等大型資料中心營運商代工伺服器的企業，已陸續通知客戶即將調漲價格。輝達代表則未回應評論要求。
在AI基礎建設需求大幅成長之際，連產業中最具主導地位的輝達都無法維持原有價格或自行吸收不斷增加的成本，凸顯記憶體晶片製造商三星電子、SK海力士(000660KS) 及美光科技(MU-US) 的議價能力之強大。
市場數據顯示，2026年第2季DRAM合約價格季增64%，NAND合約價格同期也上漲54%；此外，伺服器DDR5第3季價格仍面臨進一步上漲壓力。
HBM則因為是AI伺服器的重要記憶體配置，價格溢價更為明顯。相關市場資料顯示，HBM產品溢價已超過300%，而單台AI伺服器所使用的DRAM容量約為傳統伺服器的8至10倍。
高盛(GS-US) 更是預估，2026年全年DRAM市場價格可能上漲250%至280%。若這項預測成真，記憶體價格上行將不再只是單一零組件的短期波動，而可能成為AI資料中心建置成本的重要變數。
包括蘋果(AAPL-US) 與高通(QCOM-US) 在內的主要科技企業近期也表示，由於晶片供應短缺，他們被迫提高產品價格。
輝達的AI加速處理器是用於建立及執行AI軟體的電腦核心元件，其效能取決於搭配多少動態隨機存取記憶體（DRAM）。
三星電子、SK海力士及美光這3家公司掌握全球大部分DRAM產能。儘管上述三家公司持續提高產量，但目前仍無法跟上需求快速成長的速度，推動這類標準化元件的價格大幅上漲。
輝達是半導體產業中獲利能力最強的企業之一。由於代工廠台積電(2330-TW) 的晶片供應仍無法滿足失控般的市場需求，輝達得以將單顆晶片售價拉高至數萬美元。
輝達的毛利率，也就是扣除生產成本後的銷售收入占比，目前達到75%。
輝達的AI加速器最初源自售價數百美元的PC遊戲晶片，但隨著需求持續強勁，加上目前市場上仍缺乏足以取代輝達產品的可行方案，其價格也不斷攀升。
根據《Tom's Hardware》本月稍早報導，輝達也已提高面向遊戲市場的PC顯示卡價格。
至於輝達客戶將如何因應此次最新漲價，以及此舉是否會為競爭對手創造切入機會，很可能取決於這些客戶能否自行取得足夠的記憶體供應。
亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、微軟、Google及Meta(META-US) 等主要客戶目前都在積極推動自研晶片計畫，但資料中心建置仍依賴向輝達採購產品。
報導指出，這些企業能否進一步降低對輝達的依賴，也將取決於它們能否從三星電子、SK海力士及美光取得足夠的記憶體供應。
伺服器價格上漲也可能進一步增加業界大規模建置AI資料中心的複雜度。目前許多相關計畫已受到專案延誤、勞動力短缺、資本市場緊縮，以及地方社區反對開發等因素影響。
輝達預計下週公布會計年度第二季財報，預計將成為科技產業及投資人的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: As memory chip costs soar, some of Nvidia's (NVDA-US) large customers have been told that servers equipped with Nvidia AI chips will see price increases of more than 15% in many cases.

According to Bloomberg, insiders said the price hike is expected to apply to systems shipping early next year, including servers using Nvidia's latest Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell chips. They added that the actual increase will depend on the generation of Nvidia chips and the memory configuration.
Analysts noted that Bloomberg singled out Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell because both reflect the growing demand for memory and storage resources in AI computing.

The Grace Blackwell platform has already shown a high demand for high‑performance memory such as HBM and DDR5. As component costs rise, Nvidia has previously raised prices for its H200 and B200 chips and modules, and server makers have adjusted their quotes accordingly, with hikes of roughly 10% to 15%.

For the next‑generation Vera Rubin platform, memory configurations are expected to become even more aggressive. Samsung Electronics (005930KS) has announced that its enterprise SSD PM1763 will support Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform, offering read‑write speeds double those of the previous generation.

It is increasingly noteworthy that memory configuration is becoming a key variable in AI server pricing. Even with the same generation of AI chips, different memory capacities and configurations can lead to significant cost differences.

Sources said that companies currently manufacturing servers for large data‑center operators such as Microsoft (MSFT-US), Alphabet’s Google, and Oracle (ORCL-US) have begun notifying customers of upcoming price increases. Nvidia declined to comment.

Even the industry leader Nvidia cannot maintain its current pricing or absorb the rising costs on its own, highlighting the strong bargaining power of memory chip makers Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix (000660KS) and Micron Technology (MU-US).

Market data shows that DRAM contract prices jumped 64% quarter‑over‑quarter in Q2 2026, while NAND contract prices rose 54% over the same period; server DDR5 prices are also under further upward pressure in Q3.

HBM, a critical memory component for AI servers, is seeing an even sharper premium. Market data indicates HBM products now carry a premium of over 300%, and a single AI server uses roughly 8‑10 times the DRAM capacity of a traditional server.

Goldman Sachs (GS-US) forecasts that DRAM market prices could rise 250%‑280% over the full year 2026. If that materializes, memory price increases will no longer be a short‑term blip for a single component but a major factor in AI data‑center build costs.
Major tech firms including Apple (AAPL-US) and Qualcomm (QCOM-US) have recently said that chip shortages forced them to raise product prices.
Nvidia's AI accelerators are core components for building and running AI software, and their performance depends on how much dynamic random‑access memory (DRAM) they are paired with.

Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron together control the bulk of global DRAM capacity. Although they are expanding output, they still cannot keep pace with the rapid surge in demand, driving steep price hikes for these standardized parts.

Nvidia is one of the most profitable companies in the semiconductor sector. Because TSMC (2330-TW) cannot meet the runaway market demand, Nvidia has been able to push single‑chip prices into the tens of thousands of dollars.
Nvidia's gross margin—sales revenue after production costs—currently sits at 75%.
Nvidia's AI accelerators originated from PC gaming chips that sold for a few hundred dollars, but sustained strong demand and the lack of viable alternatives have continually pushed prices upward.
Earlier this month Tom's Hardware reported that Nvidia has also raised the prices of its PC graphics cards aimed at the gaming market.
How Nvidia's customers will respond to the latest price hike, and whether it creates an opening for rivals, will likely hinge on whether they can secure enough memory supply on their own.
Major customers such as Amazon (AMZN-US), Microsoft, Google and Meta (META-US) are actively pursuing in‑house chip projects, yet their data‑center builds still rely heavily on Nvidia products.
Reports say that these firms' ability to reduce dependence on Nvidia will also depend on securing sufficient memory from Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron.

Rising server prices could further complicate large‑scale AI data‑center deployments. Many projects are already facing delays due to labor shortages, tighter capital markets, community opposition and other challenges.
Nvidia expects to release its fiscal Q2 earnings next week, which is likely to become a key gauge for the tech sector and investors.

items.title: 「壓得住實質利率壓不住期限溢價」 策略師：「貝森特經濟學」難以避免股債碰撞
paras: 美債30年期殖利率上周二(18日)盤中觸及 5.334%，創2007年來新高，次日美國財政部宣布啟動「發短買長」式回購、單次規模可能超40億美元，30年殖利率應聲回落至5.183%，但又在上周五(21日)彈回5.276%。
《第一財經》報導，在美國聯邦債務站上40兆美元關口的陰影下，市場對財政赤字與長端通膨的擔憂並未被一則回購聲明消解。美國財長貝森特日前說，美國「有很大可能」步入赤字縮小軌道，當前殖利率「未反映潛在基本面」，尤其30年債「流動性非常差」但BCA Research核心宏觀主管Arthur Budaghyan直言：「這套『貝森特經濟學』恐怕兌現不了，股債全面碰撞難以避免。]
Budaghyan把名目美債殖利率拆成三塊：核心實際收益率、期限溢價、通膨補償。他認為，華府就算能用財政操作與預期管理壓低核心實際利率，也根本握不住後兩塊。
Budaghyan說：「近期殖利率上、美元弱，正是TIPS端抬升完全由期限溢價拉動，而核心實質殖利率已見頂回落，美元對核心實質利率下行做敏感反應。當政府越激進扭曲市場，市場索要的期限與通膨溢價就越高。」
換言之，貝森特能暫時買流動性，買不回信任。
Budaghyan認為，若10年期美債在期限溢價與通膨預期推動下穩站4.5%​之上，貝森特經濟學就擋不住股債碰撞。歷史規律上，過去45年美債殖利率的每一輪可持續見頂，都伴隨金融或實體危機，1987黑色星期一、2000網科泡沫、2008次貸、2020新冠疫情流動性危機皆然。
目前，美股經通膨調整估值處歷史趨勢線正兩倍標準差超買區，分析師長期EPS預期超 20%、甚至高於2000峰值，投資級與垃圾債利差壓到極窄，這種結構性脆弱，正好接住長端利率刺破泡泡的那一刀。
Budaghyan認為，危機情境下，華府會走「金融抑制」：在現任Fed主席排斥QE前提下，財政部可能透過監管手段逼摩根大通等大型商銀大舉承接長債，搞「商銀版 QE」。代價按「不可能三角」結算，也就是在資本自由流動＋獨立貨幣政策下，行政壓利率必然犧牲匯率穩定，財政赤字疊加外資流入放緩會把美元單邊打下來。
這一情境也引出Budaghyan認為「全面撤離美元」框架。對比 1971 尼克森衝擊前：當年政府債務佔GDP比重僅35%且下行、基本赤字近0；如今債務率 120%、基本赤字佔 GDP 5.8%。
外部失衡更尖銳，因當前美國經常帳赤字近 1.18 兆美元，FDI淨流入基本為零，過去一年外資淨買超長期證券1.33 兆(其中股票 9090億)撐著赤字。
BCA 稱此為「鱷魚嘴」，上顎是上兆美元級的證券流入，下顎是兆元級經常帳黑洞。若未來12個月證券流入1兆腰斬到5000 億，再平衡只能靠美元大跌逼縮進口。
未來12個月美元進入較大幅度貶值週期，從逆週期避險貨幣轉為順週期貨幣，歐元則可能重塑為逆週期錨。AI 與生產力敘事再長期正確，未來 6–12 個月美股與科技股仍要消化極度高估值，貝森特用回購買到的24小時回落，換不回期限溢價定價權。當財政部開始替Fed管長端利率，市場要的補償只會更高，而不是更低。

items.title: Anthropic拚2兆美元IPO加速自研AI晶片！挖角Google TPU大將、降低對輝達依賴
paras: Anthropic正從擴大外部採購轉向「自研＋多元採購」並行，延攬Google(GOOGL-US) 客製化晶片業務創辦人Amir Salek組建自研團隊，同時與多家業者合作，提前鎖定2027年約3.5GW的TPU容量，藉此降低對輝達(NVDA-US) 的依賴並壓低推理成本。
在籌備可能達到2兆美元估值的IPO之際，Anthropic開始從過去積極採購外部算力，進一步轉向自行設計AI晶片，試圖降低對單一晶片供應商的依賴。
週五（21日），Anthropic宣布聘請Google客製化晶片業務創辦人Amir Salek，負責成立並帶領AI客製化晶片設計團隊。
分析指出，Salek的加入，被視為Anthropic建立自主晶片設計能力的重要一步。
Salek過去曾在輝達任職8年，創立並帶領系統單晶片（SoC）設計團隊，參與GPU及Tegra晶片研發。2013年，他加入Google並從零建立客製化晶片業務，主導前7代TPU晶片的研發。
Salek在2022年離開Google後，轉任Cerberus Capital Management高級董事總經理，主要負責半導體與AI領域投資。
加入Anthropic後，Salek將向James Bradbury匯報，負責組建及領導AI客製化晶片設計團隊。此外，Anthropic也將與三星(005930KS) 合作進行硬體及模型設計，以提升AI模型運行速度與效率。
Anthropic此舉也與AI產業加速客製化晶片的趨勢一致。OpenAI已與博通合作開發針對推理工作負載設計的Jalapeno晶片，Google DeepMind則長期使用自家TPU，Meta(META-US) 也持續推進MTIA加速器。
對Anthropic而言，自研晶片的潛在優勢在於能依照自身AI模型的架構與運算需求調整硬體設計，進一步降低對通用型外部晶片的依賴。
不過，在自主晶片真正投入使用前，Anthropic仍需要大量依靠外部供應商滿足快速增加的算力需求。
因此，公司也持續擴大外部算力採購，包括與英國晶片新創Fractile達成約2.5億美元的首批採購協議，並深化與Google、博通(AVGO-US) 的合作，以提前取得2027年約3.5GW的下一代TPU容量。
這部分容量並不包含Google Cloud去年10月協議中、預計於2026年交付的1GW容量。
博通在Anthropic的算力布局中也扮演重要角色，除了負責開發及供應客製化TPU，也承諾為Google下一代AI機架提供網路元件，合作期限延伸至2031年。
除了晶片之外，Anthropic也持續擴張資料中心容量。公司已與傳統雲端服務商、晶片業者及新興算力供應商簽署多項容量協議，合作對象包括Riot Platforms (RIOT-US) 及Volta Infra Holdings等，相關合約規模達數百億美元。
市場估計，Anthropic目前超過一半的長期算力由Google Cloud上的TPU提供。在Google自身算力增長放緩的情況下，Anthropic也進一步尋找其他供應來源，以支應自身快速增加的運算需求。

算力布局成IPO估值關鍵　Anthropic加速掌握成本

Anthropic積極投入晶片與算力基礎設施，與公司近期快速成長的營運數據密切相關。
截至7月底，Anthropic年化營收已突破650億美元；第二季初步收入超過115億美元，年增超過14倍。
同期，公司推理基礎設施毛利率從38%大幅提升至超過70%，調整後營業利益也首度轉正。
Anthropic財務長Krishna Rao將相關投資形容為公司至今在計算領域最重要的投入之一，主要目的是因應客戶規模快速擴張所帶來的算力需求。
對於準備進入公開市場、目標估值可能達2兆美元的Anthropic而言，算力已不只是支撐AI模型運作的基礎設施，更直接牽動模型推理成本與供應鏈掌控能力。

items.title: 伊朗高層喊話結束戰爭！經濟危機惡化、荷姆茲海峽成僵局
items.title_en: Iranian Leaders Call for End to War Amid Worsening Economic Crisis and Strait of Hormuz Stalemate
paras: 伊朗最高層政治人物表示，當前國家應把重點放在結束戰爭，以及挽救已陷入困境的經濟，公開反駁國內強硬派在這場持續6個月的衝突中採取更為強硬、不妥協的立場。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚（Masoud Pezeshkian）與國會議長加利巴夫（Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf）發表上述言論之際，外交途徑仍陷入停滯，而川普政府則轉向透過制裁及海軍封鎖伊朗港口等方式，逐步加大經濟施壓。
戰爭與經濟限制措施進一步加劇伊朗原本已陷入惡化的經濟局勢，使伊朗貨幣進一步貶值，也讓伊朗民眾更難負擔日常生活所需。德黑蘭較為溫和的領導人擔心，持續升高的壓力最終可能動搖國家的穩定。
然而，目前仍不清楚，近期對重新開放荷姆茲海峽提出嚴格新要求的伊朗強硬派，是否能與要求伊朗作出重大讓步、且本週再次呼籲伊朗政權垮台的川普政府達成協議。
據伊朗媒體報導，佩澤希齊揚週五（21日）表示：「戰爭終究必須在某個時刻結束。如今展現我們的力量與尊嚴，告訴全世界我們已經獲勝，並且正在結束戰爭，會是更好的做法。」
加利巴夫的表態較為含蓄，但他表示，如果國家忽視經濟危機，就不可能實現安全。
他表示：「無論我們擁有多麼強大的軍事力量，如果人民正陷於困境，而國家缺乏資金流動與經濟成長，我們就無法取得進展。作為一名經歷過戰爭的人，我們理解和平真正的價值。」
分析人士認為，這些言論凸顯伊朗當前面臨的經濟困境，但由於目前仍缺乏可行的協議條件，與其期待戰爭結束，衝突進一步升級的可能性反而更高。
伊朗強硬派對美國政府高度不信任，並正利用目前衝突暫歇的空檔，為可能爆發的新一輪戰事做準備。
美國總統川普在整場戰爭期間都清楚表達希望達成協議的意願。然而，他6月簽署、旨在逐步結束戰爭的諒解備忘錄，因伊朗試圖管控荷姆茲海峽的航運而告破局。
此外，基於美方拒絕接受無法保證船隻暢通通過該水道的協議，美伊本月初的談判同樣陷入停滯。
這兩項協議都曾在美國國內遭到批評，被認為對伊朗過於有利，進一步增加川普政府採取更強硬立場的壓力。
川普週五表示：「他們非常希望達成協議，但他們還沒有準備好達成一項正確的協議。」
伊朗問題分析師Hamidreza Azizi表示，川普似乎正準備利用伊朗的經濟困境，要求德黑蘭作出更大幅度的讓步。然而，這種壓力反而讓伊朗更難避免以一種屈辱的方式退讓。
Azizi在社群媒體上表示：「這正在形成一個惡性循環。」
曾任以色列國防情報部門伊朗事務處主管的Danny Citrinowicz週五表示，美伊雙方目前似乎都還沒有準備好作出必要的妥協。
他在社群媒體上寫道：「因此，儘管加利巴夫與佩澤希齊揚釋放出相關訊號，目前局勢升級的可能性正在上升，而非下降。」
paras_en: Iran's top political figures said the country must now focus on ending the war and rescuing an economy already in trouble, publicly rejecting hard‑liners at home who have taken an even tougher, uncompromising stance in the six‑month conflict.

According to the Wall Street Journal, President Masoud Pezeshkian and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf made those remarks while diplomatic channels remain stalled and the Trump administration has turned to sanctions and naval blockades of Iranian ports to increase economic pressure.

The war and economic restrictions are further aggravating Iran’s already deteriorating economy, causing the currency to depreciate further and making daily life harder for ordinary Iranians. Tehran’s more moderate leaders fear that mounting pressure could eventually destabilise the country.

However, it remains unclear whether Iran’s hard‑liners, who have recently imposed strict new demands for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, can reach a deal with the Trump administration, which this week again called for the collapse of the Iranian regime and is demanding major concessions from Tehran.

Iranian media reported that Pezeshkian said on Friday the 21st, “The war must eventually end at some point. Now is the time to demonstrate our strength and dignity, tell the world we have won, and that we are ending the war – that would be the better approach.”
Ghalibaf’s response was more measured, but he warned that ignoring the economic crisis makes security unattainable.

He said, “No matter how powerful our military is, if the people are suffering and the country lacks cash flow and economic growth, we cannot make progress. As someone who has lived through war, we understand the true value of peace.”

Analysts say the statements highlight Iran’s current economic woes, but because there is still no viable agreement on the table, the likelihood of the conflict escalating may be higher than that of a swift end to the war.
Iran’s hard‑liners harbour deep mistrust of the U.S. government and are using the current lull in fighting to prepare for a possible new round of hostilities.

U.S. President Donald Trump has consistently expressed a desire to reach a deal throughout the war. However, the memorandum of understanding he signed in June, intended to gradually end the war, fell apart after Iran tried to control shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
In addition, negotiations earlier this month stalled because the U.S. refused to accept any agreement that could not guarantee free passage of vessels through the strait.
Both agreements were criticised domestically in the United States as being too favorable to Iran, adding pressure on the Trump administration to adopt a tougher stance.
Trump said on Friday, “They are very eager to reach a deal, but they are not yet ready to reach a proper agreement.”

Iran analyst Hamidreza Azizi said Trump appears to be preparing to exploit Iran’s economic distress to force Tehran into larger concessions, but that pressure only makes it harder for Iran to avoid a humiliating retreat.
Azizi wrote on social media, “This is turning into a vicious cycle.”
Former Israeli defense intelligence officer for Iran affairs Danny Citrinowicz said on Friday that both sides still seem unready to make the necessary compromises.
He posted, “So, even though Ghalibaf and Pezeshkian are sending signals, the likelihood of escalation is rising, not falling.”

items.title: 智易5G拉貨與Wi-Fi 7升級雙動能加持 下半年營運優於上半年
items.title_en: ZhiYi's 5G Order Pull and Wi‑Fi 7 Upgrade Dual‑Engine Boost Outlook, H2 Operations Better Than H1
paras: 網通大廠智易(3596-TW)受惠於美國兩大電信運營商客戶5G產品拉貨，以及Wi-Fi 7升級雙動能加持，法人看好，下半年營收表現將優於上半年，第3季營收可望持續向上墊高。
在產業前景與產品線展望方面，智易旗下三大產品線中以移動通訊Mobility表現最為突出，優於智慧家庭Smart Home與寬頻Broadband業務，惟受到上游PCB等材料交期拉長影響，營收成長幅度略微下修。
在規格升級趨勢下，2026年邁入Wi-Fi 7出貨第二年，美洲與歐洲市場的Wi-Fi 7出貨占比預計將由去年的初期階段大幅攀升至80%以上，有助於拉抬平均銷售單價與毛利表現。
在業務轉型與新產品布局端，智易正加速由傳統家用網通設備跨足企業市場，旗下交換器Switch及企業級Wi-Fi Access Point預計自今年下半年起逐步出貨，預估明年企業級產品占營收比重有望挑戰雙位數水準。
針對美國新客戶的XGS-PON光纖相關設備與Cable產品，則因記憶體價格波動因素，預計將遞延至2027年正式出貨。
在供應鏈備料策略上，智易第2季存貨攀升至277億元，季增44%且年增118%，占總資產比重達51%。其中約46%存貨為包含Dram與Flash在內的記憶體零組件，主要是因應市場價格上漲與供應吃緊而提前備妥至2027年的需求，儘管備料導致短期借款增加，但公司已與客戶達成協議由對方支付部分款項或補貼資金成本，有效降低財務負擔。
paras_en: Network equipment giant ZhiYi (3596‑TW) is benefiting from increased 5G product orders from two major US telecom operators and the dual‑engine boost of Wi‑Fi 7 upgrades. Analysts are optimistic that revenue in the second half of the year will outperform the first half, with Q3 revenue expected to keep rising.

Regarding industry outlook and product line prospects, ZhiYi’s three main product lines show that the Mobility segment for mobile communications performs the best, outpacing the Smart Home and Broadband businesses. However, longer lead times for upstream materials such as PCBs have slightly trimmed the revenue growth rate.

With the trend of specification upgrades, 2026 marks the second year of Wi‑Fi 7 shipments. The share of Wi‑Fi 7 shipments in the Americas and Europe is expected to jump from the early‑stage level last year to over 80%, helping lift average selling prices and gross margin performance.

In terms of business transformation and new product rollout, ZhiYi is accelerating its move from traditional home networking equipment into the enterprise market. Its switches and enterprise‑grade Wi‑Fi access points are slated to ship gradually from the second half of this year, and the share of enterprise products in revenue is projected to reach double‑digit levels next year.
For new US customers’ XGS‑PON fiber‑related equipment and cable products, delivery is expected to be deferred to 2027 due to memory price volatility.

Regarding supply‑chain inventory strategy, ZhiYi’s Q2 inventory rose to NT$27.7 billion, up 44% quarter‑over‑quarter and 118% year‑over‑year, representing 51% of total assets. About 46% of this inventory consists of memory components such as DRAM and flash, stocked in advance to meet demand through 2027 amid rising market prices and tight supply. Although the stocking increased short‑term borrowings, the company has reached agreements with customers for partial payment or cost‑subsidy, effectively reducing its financial burden.

paras_en: In the AI‑cake theory, energy is the foundational layer for AI industry development; power equals compute is a global consensus. As the next‑generation AI chips and server racks see exponential power consumption growth, a full‑link power‑supply architecture revolution—from on‑site generation at the front end, to high‑voltage DC transmission within the data hall, to vertical power delivery at the chip level—has fully unfolded, reshaping the energy landscape of the compute era.
<Rise of On‑Site Generation at Facilities, SOFC and SST Pave the Way for Efficient Power Supply>

Facing the challenges of traditional grid interconnection delays and capacity saturation, deploying autonomous on‑site energy—‘post‑meter self‑generation’—has become the strategic first choice to accelerate compute deployment. Solid‑oxide fuel cells (SOFC) stand out for their short construction time, low noise, and water‑free operation, driving explosive demand growth. Solid‑state transformers can directly convert medium‑voltage AC to high‑voltage DC for rack delivery, dramatically cutting conversion stages, boosting system efficiency, and saving data‑hall space, making them a key core of future micro‑grid architectures.
<High‑Voltage DC Becomes Inevitable, BBU and Vertical Power Redesign Racks>

Inside data halls, traditional 48 V low‑voltage supply suffers from massive current‑induced line loss and heavy copper bus constraints, prompting a shift toward high‑voltage DC. Currently, major U.S. CSP vendors favor ±400 VDC that complies with existing safety standards, while 800 VDC will follow as next‑generation high‑power chips scale up. Battery‑backed units (BBU) with low loss and microsecond‑level response are rapidly replacing conventional UPS, paired with independent Power Rack designs. Board‑level power is also moving to modular vertical delivery, leveraging SiC and GaN wide‑bandgap materials to minimize resistance and transmission loss.

items.title: 南下建立協同機制 迅得擬投資友上科技1.5億元拿下逾20%股權
items.title_en: Southward Collaboration Mechanism: XunDe Plans to Invest NT$1.5 Billion in YouShang Technology for Over 20% Stake
paras: 在南台灣半導體S 廊帶的成型之下，設備業在爭取更進一步的生產協同機制，也陸續展開在台灣的生產投資，台積電(2330-TW)供應鏈的迅得(6438-TW)通過將出資1.5億元資金，參與在南科設立的友上科技(6998-TW)的增資案，預計年底前將拿下友上的逾20%股權。
而這迅得的此一投資案件如果成行，也將成為繼設備業牧德(3563-TW)以2.74億元投資鏵友益(6877-TW)及志聖(2467-TW)以10.17億元投資東捷(8064-TW)私募案後，另一件設備廠南下建立協同機制的案例。
設立於台灣南科園區 ，目前以生產AMHS智能工廠系統、智慧製造設備及機器手臂系統整合的友上科技，目前股本爲3.64億元，自2023年起連續虧損3年，而友上 科技 2026年上半年營收6253萬元，毛利率14.94%，稅後仍虧損4890萬元，每股淨損1.34元。
友上科技目前也是迅得的合作供應鏈，而迅得經董事會通過將出資1.5億元投資，迅得董事長王年清指出，預計迅得將在友上科技減資彌補虧損後以1.5億元參與其現金增資，預計將取得友上科技逾20%的股權。
王年清指出，友上科技在AMHS智能工廠系統核心技術上有十足成長潛力，也看好友上科技在2027年的營運將可望轉盈，而目前股本3.64億元的友上科技已股票公開發行，規劃2029年登錄興櫃交易。
迅得2026年1-6月營收35.68億元，毛利率26.13%，稅後純益3.11億元，每股純益3.79元。而迅得公布最新營收資訊，迅得2026 年 7 月營收以 6.38 億元改寫歷年同期新高。迅得 2026 年 7 月營收 6.38 億元，月增 7.61%，年增 5.38%。2026 年 1-7 月營收 42.07 億元，年增 10.97%。
迅得營運總部也在遷入的新生廠，產能已進人滿載，將推升 2026 年獲利成長幅度攀高。迅得機械在 2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創新高，法人估計迅得 2026 年第三季單月平均營收在 6 億元之上 ，有機會再創新高，第四季由於安排出貨的半導體設備出貨逐步步入高峰，預估下半年營運勝過 上半年，全年營收將再較 2025 年的 64.67 億元再增 10-15%，再創新高。
迅得擁有在半導體及 PCB 設備需求雙重成長動能，同時，迅得在 PCB 設備指向高階產品廠商的需求，也與臻鼎 - KY(4958-TW) 及景碩 (3189-TW) 有大單確立，其中臻鼎 - KY 下單 10.2 億元，而景碩也在 7 億元之上。。
迅得 2026 年上半年營收 35.68 億元，年增 11.99%，2026 下半年預估在出貨產品組合的有利因素加持下超過上半年表現 ，全年營收估成長 10-15%，而在獲利成長幅度可望以優於營收成長幅度倍數成長呈現。
同時，迅得半導體相關設備出貨上將在第四季起出現明顯成長，半導體設備營收在 2027 年也將維持此一營運旺盛態勢。
而志聖以10.17億元投資東捷私募案，也在整合其台南南科與樹谷萬坪廠房，提供高度靈活組裝產線，擴大生產韌性。在服務上更將強化在 S 廊帶關鍵據點提供零時差的技術支援與維護，提升服務彈性。
paras_en: In the wake of the formation of the semiconductor “S‑lane” in southern Taiwan, equipment makers are seeking deeper production collaboration mechanisms and are gradually launching manufacturing investments in Taiwan. XunDe (6438‑TW), a supplier in TSMC’s (2330‑TW) supply chain, will invest NT$1.5 billion to participate in a capital increase of YouShang Technology (6998‑TW) set up in the Southern Science Park, and expects to acquire more than 20% of YouShang’s equity by the end of the year.

If XunDe’s investment goes through, it will become another example of a southern‑Taiwan equipment maker establishing a collaborative mechanism, following Mude (3563‑TW)’s NT$2.74 billion private placement in MiaoYouYi (6877‑TW) and ZhiSheng’s (2467‑TW) NT$10.17 billion private placement in DongJie (8064‑TW).

YouShang Technology, located in the Southern Science Park, currently produces AMHS smart‑factory systems, intelligent manufacturing equipment and robotic‑arm integration solutions. Its capital is NT$364 million, and it has posted losses for three consecutive years since 2023. In the first half of 2026, YouShang recorded revenue of NT$62.53 million, a gross margin of 14.94%, and a post‑tax loss of NT$48.90 million, equating to a loss of NT$1.34 per share.

YouShang is already a partner in XunDe’s supply chain. After the board approved a NT$1.5 billion investment, Chairman Wang Nian‑qing said XunDe will join YouShang’s cash capital increase after YouShang’s capital reduction to offset losses, and expects to secure over 20% of the company’s shares.

Wang noted that YouShang’s core technology for AMHS smart‑factory systems has strong growth potential and that the company is expected to turn profitable by 2027. YouShang’s NT$364 million capital has already been publicly issued, and the firm plans to list on the Emerging Stock Board in 2029.

XunDe posted revenue of NT$3.568 billion for the first half of 2026, with a gross margin of 26.13% and a net profit of NT$311 million, or NT$3.79 earnings per share. The company also reported a record July 2026 revenue of NT$638 million, up 7.61% month‑over‑month and 5.38% year‑over‑year. Revenue for January‑July 2026 reached NT$4.207 billion, a 10.97% annual increase.

XunDe’s operations headquarters moved into a new plant that is now operating at full capacity, which should boost profit growth in 2026. The company’s Q2 2026 revenue hit a new high of NT$1.824 billion, and analysts estimate Q3 2026 average monthly revenue will stay above NT$600 million, potentially setting another record. With semiconductor‑equipment shipments expected to peak in Q4, the second half of the year is forecast to outperform the first half, and full‑year revenue could rise another 10‑15% over the 2025 level of NT$6.467 billion, reaching a new high.

XunDe benefits from dual growth drivers in semiconductor and PCB equipment demand. It also secured large orders from high‑end PCB equipment makers, including ZhenDing‑KY (4958‑TW) and JingShuo (3189‑TW). ZhenDing‑KY placed an order worth NT$1.02 billion, while JingShuo’s order exceeds NT$700 million.

XunDe’s H1 2026 revenue of NT$3.568 billion grew 11.99% year‑over‑year. The company expects H2 2026 performance to exceed H1 thanks to favorable product‑mix factors, projecting total‑year revenue growth of 10‑15% and profit growth outpacing revenue growth at a multiple rate.
Furthermore, shipments of XunDe’s semiconductor‑related equipment are expected to show clear growth starting in Q4, and semiconductor‑equipment revenue should remain robust throughout 2027.

ZhiSheng’s NT$10.17 billion private placement in DongJie also integrates its Southern Science Park and Shugu Wanping facilities in Tainan, providing highly flexible assembly lines and expanding production resilience. Service-wise, it will strengthen zero‑delay technical support and maintenance at key S‑lane locations, enhancing service flexibility.

items.title: 矽晶圓終於翻身！徐秀蘭證實現貨、長約都上漲
items.title_en: Silicon Wafer Finally Turns Around! Xu Xiulan Confirms Spot and Long-Term Prices Both Rising
paras: 近期矽晶圓市況明顯升溫，業界傳出，客戶搶貨情況加劇，甚至有客戶願意接受漲價雙位數以鞏固料源。環球晶(6488-TW)董事長徐秀蘭日前受訪時證實矽晶圓漲價趨勢，難掩期待直言「等了很久，終於等到了」，指出現階段不論現貨或長約價格都在上漲，尤其生產成本持續攀升，公司也正與客戶協商，希望進一步反映成本，「想辦法讓客戶加價加得更多」。
業界指出，矽晶圓產業歷經長時間庫存調整後，近期需求回溫速度超預期，也讓部分客戶為確保後續產能供應，開始提前卡位，甚至出現願意接受調漲雙位數的情況，顯示矽晶圓產業過去經過長達半年的價格討論終於塵埃落定，供需結構正出現轉捩點。
對此，徐秀蘭表示，目前矽晶圓市場確實已經進入漲價階段，且漲勢並非僅限於短期現貨市場，包括長期合約價格也同步向上，反映客戶對後續需求及供應能見度的態度正在改變。
業界認為，由於過去在疫情期間談的矽晶圓長約部分將在今、明兩年到期，因此需要重新議約，考量過去兩三年原物料價格、電費、建廠費用等成本上漲超乎預期，因此業界早已有共識普遍改採新價格，漲幅至少雙位數起跳。
此外，現階段不論成熟製程、先進製程與記憶體，甚至第三代半導體如氮化鎵(GaN)、碳化矽(SiC)等，都在AI領域中分別扮演關鍵角色，象徵矽晶圓不僅由先進製程撐腰，而是整體矽晶圓市況呈現百花齊放。
也因此有多家業者已積極卡位矽晶圓產能，願意加價鞏固料源、避免未來缺料風險，長約期限也有進一步拉長的趨勢，可望為環球晶等矽晶圓業者創造更有利的價格環境。
徐秀蘭指出，目前矽晶圓長約佔整體產能比重仍低，主要因新一波長約才剛開始簽訂，未來長約比重將持續攀升，環球晶也會根據長約需求同步規劃產能，且因公司在全球佈局橫跨三大洲，會依照客戶需求選擇距離較近的生產據點進行擴產。
paras_en: Recently, the silicon wafer market has clearly heated up, with industry sources reporting intensified competition among customers for supplies, and even some customers willing to accept double‑digit price increases to secure material sources. GlobalWafers (6488‑TW) chairman Xu Xiulan confirmed the upward price trend in a recent interview, saying she had been waiting a long time and finally sees the rise, noting that both spot and long‑term contract prices are climbing, especially as production costs continue to surge. The company is negotiating with customers to further reflect these costs, aiming to get customers to pay even more.

Industry observers note that after a long period of inventory adjustments, demand has rebounded faster than expected, prompting some customers to lock in capacity early and even agree to double‑digit price hikes. This shows that the half‑year‑long price discussions in the silicon wafer sector have finally settled, and the supply‑demand balance is reaching a turning point.

Xu Xiulan said the silicon wafer market has indeed entered a price‑increase phase, and the upward pressure is not limited to the short‑term spot market; long‑term contract prices are also rising in tandem, reflecting a shift in customers’ outlook on future demand and supply visibility.

The industry believes that many long‑term wafer contracts negotiated during the pandemic are set to expire this year and next, requiring renegotiation. Given that raw material, electricity, and plant‑building costs have risen far beyond expectations over the past two to three years, there is a broad consensus to adopt new pricing, with increases starting at double‑digit levels.

Moreover, at present, both mature and advanced process wafers, as well as memory wafers and third‑generation semiconductors such as gallium nitride (GaN) and silicon carbide (SiC), each play key roles in AI applications, indicating that the silicon wafer market is thriving across a wide range of technologies, not just advanced nodes.

Consequently, many manufacturers are actively securing wafer capacity, willing to pay higher prices to lock in material sources and avoid future shortages. Long‑term contract terms are also being extended, which should create a more favorable pricing environment for silicon wafer producers like GlobalWafers.

Xu Xiulan pointed out that long‑term contracts currently account for a small share of total capacity because the new wave of contracts has only just begun. Their share will continue to rise, and GlobalWafers will align capacity planning with long‑term demand. With operations spanning three continents, the company will expand production at sites closer to customers based on demand.

items.title: 國際利空頻傳震盪洗籌碼 法人看台股：大箱型格局「以盤待變」
items.title_en: International Negative Sentiment Triggers Volatility and Chip Washing; Institutions View Taiwan Stocks: Large-Box Pattern ‘Wait for Change on the Board’
paras: 台股全周下跌586.72點、跌幅1.28%，周線收黑，上市總市值降至147.84兆元。投信法人指出，大盤目前維持「高檔震盪、輪動墊高」的大箱型整理格局，資金持續在電子、金融與傳產間健康輪動，有助於反覆消化漲多後的估值壓力並洗清籌碼，後市將以盤待變，等待進一步突破。
美債殖利率居高不下與地緣政治陰霾籠罩，國際金融市場持續動盪。儘管美國財政部擴大債券回購，長天期美債殖利率仍高檔震盪，加上美伊情勢升溫推升國際油價，拖累美股走勢，台股同樣震盪。
針對近期盤勢變化，安聯台灣大壩基金經理人蕭惠中分析，台股目前正步入高檔整理與產業輪動階段，8月以來持續維持「大箱型整理」格局。雖然短期受估值修正與地緣政治牽動而走勢震盪，但觀察長線基本面，AI產業成長趨勢確立、企業獲利預估持續上修，搭配市場資金動能充沛，台股中長期多頭架構依然相當完整。
蕭惠中指出，歷經前波劇烈波動後，近期大盤成交量已有明顯收縮，顯示籌碼正逐漸沉澱，預期短線大盤將以「高檔震盪、輪動墊高」為主軸，在量縮區間內以盤待變，等待進一步突破的契機。
安聯台灣高息成長主動式ETF(00984A-TW)經理人廖本隆則認為，指數來到區間上緣雖引發震盪，但資金持續在各類股間健康輪動，有助於消化漲多後的估值壓力並清洗籌碼。
展望後市，在政策面上，市場目光轉向即將登場的 Jackson Hole 全球央行年會。美國聯準會官員談話將是研判通膨、利率及金融條件走向的核心指標。此外，美國通膨與消費數據、歐美 PMI 以及主要企業財報，均為近期盤面焦點。
蕭惠中強調，AI 仍是中長線核心，儘管高利率環境對科技股估值形成壓力，但 AI 基礎建設、半導體與雲端運算需求依然強勁，企業算力投資與融資規模持續擴大。廖本隆補充，隨著盤勢歷經大漲，投資策略應更重視企業「獲利成長實際落地」情形與評價合理性；透過主動式投資靈活調整配置，將更有利於掌握市場輪動機會。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market fell 586.72 points for the week, a 1.28% decline, closing the week in the red and reducing the total market capitalization of listed companies to NT$147.84 trillion. Institutional investors note that the market is currently in a large‑box consolidation pattern of “high‑level oscillation and rotating higher lows.” Capital continues to rotate healthily among electronics, finance and traditional industries, helping to digest valuation pressure after the rally and to clean up chips. Going forward, the market will wait on the board for a change, awaiting a further breakout.

U.S. Treasury yields remain elevated and geopolitical clouds loom, keeping international financial markets turbulent. Despite the U.S. Treasury expanding bond repurchase operations, long‑term U.S. yields stay in a high‑level oscillation. Coupled with rising U.S.–Iran tensions that have lifted global oil prices, U.S. equities are being dragged down, and Taiwan’s market is similarly volatile.

Commenting on recent market moves, Allianz Taiwan’s Da‑Ba Fund manager Hsu Hui‑chung analyzes that Taiwan’s market is now entering a high‑level consolidation and sector‑rotation phase, maintaining a “large‑box consolidation” pattern since August. Although short‑term trends are shaky due to valuation corrections and geopolitical pulls, the long‑term fundamentals show a solid AI industry growth trajectory, continued upward revisions of corporate earnings forecasts, and ample market liquidity, keeping the medium‑to‑long‑term bullish structure of Taiwan stocks fairly intact.

Hsu points out that after the previous wave of sharp volatility, recent market turnover has noticeably contracted, indicating that chips are gradually settling. He expects the short‑term market to stay in a “high‑level oscillation and rotating higher lows” mode, with reduced volume and a wait‑on‑the‑board stance for the next breakout opportunity.

Allianz Taiwan High‑Yield Growth Active ETF (00984A‑TW) manager Liao Pen‑lung believes that although the index hitting the upper range of its band has sparked volatility, capital continues to rotate healthily among various sectors, aiding the digestion of valuation pressure after the rally and the cleaning of chips.

Looking ahead, market attention shifts to the upcoming Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting. Remarks from Federal Reserve officials will be a core gauge for assessing inflation, interest‑rate paths and financial‑condition trends. In addition, U.S. inflation and consumer data, Euro‑American PMI releases and major corporate earnings will dominate the near‑term market focus.

Hsu emphasizes that AI remains the core theme for the medium‑to‑long term. Even though a high‑interest‑rate environment pressures tech‑stock valuations, demand for AI infrastructure, semiconductors and cloud computing stays strong, and corporate investment and financing for computing power continue to expand. Liao adds that after the market’s big rally, investment strategy should focus more on the actual realization of corporate profit growth and reasonable valuation; active management that flexibly adjusts allocations will better capture market‑rotation opportunities.

items.title: 遺贈稅法修正三讀！取消30萬分期門檻、終止為人「買單」等6大關鍵懶人包
items.title_en: Three‑Read Passage of Inheritance and Gift Tax Law Amendments! Six Key Changes Including Removal of NT$300,000 Installment Threshold and Ending the “Pay‑for‑Others” Issue
paras: 立法院昨(21)日三讀通過遺產及贈與稅法（下稱遺贈稅法）部分條文修正草案，響應憲法法庭113年憲判字第11號判決意旨。本次修法包括六大修正，包括取消稅額滿30萬元申請分期的門檻、劃一被繼承人死亡前2年內贈與特定親屬財產的遺產稅計算方式，確定由受贈人按比例負擔稅額，解決過往繼承人須為他人受贈財產無辜買單的不公平現象，維護租稅公平與財產權。
過去被繼承人死亡前2年內贈與配偶或特定親屬的財產會被視為「擬制遺產」併入遺產總額課稅，但稅款卻全由繼承人負擔，引發極大爭議。修法後第6條明定，擬制遺產的遺產稅將按受贈財產占遺產總額比例計算，由各受贈人單獨擔任納稅義務人；同時刪除遺囑執行人為納稅義務人的規定，改由遺囑執行人代為申報繳稅及申請復查。
舉例來說，富商爸爸生前留下2000萬元遺產給獨生子，但在死亡前1年贈與現任妻子1000萬元房產。若全案核定遺產稅額為300萬元，舊制下獨生子可能要獨力拿繼承遺產去繳這300萬元稅金；新制實施後，妻子拿走三分之一財產（1000萬/3000萬），就必須獨立作為納稅義務人繳納100萬元遺產稅，獨生子僅需負擔剩餘200萬元，不再當冤大頭。
此外，第17條之1配合修正，計算配偶剩餘財產差額分配請求權扣除額時，死亡前2年內贈與配偶的財產視為被繼承人現存財產，讓配偶權益與扣除數額更具合理性。以實務計算，若先生生前贈與妻子1000萬元，過去會導致請求權扣除額減少，新制將該1000萬元算回先生現存財產後，配偶可主張的扣除額將大幅提高，有效減輕遺產稅負擔。
修法也放寬多項便民徵管措施。第30條取消遺贈稅應納稅額須滿新台幣30萬元才能申請分期繳納的限制；同時增訂繼承人得採多數決方式以遺產中的存款繳稅，免去過去須全體繼承人同意才能動用遺產存款的僵局。不過，若受贈人申請以遺產抵繳或繳納擬制遺產稅額，仍須經全體繼承人同意。
第23條與第41條則分別規範法院判決確定遺產權屬案件的申報與核課期間起算日，以及授權納稅義務人提供應稅不動產設定抵押權給稽徵機關後，即可申請核發同意移轉證明書。第51條則刪除原滯納金規定，回歸依稅捐稽徵法統一辦理。
財政部表示，目前正加速研擬遺贈稅法施行細則等子法規，並調整申報書表與線上申辦系統，待總統公布實施後將全面宣導，利於徵納雙方依循。
遺贈稅法修法「六大關鍵重點」新舊制與效益對照表
paras_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the third reading of amendments to certain provisions of the Inheritance and Gift Tax Act (hereafter the Gift Tax Act) on the 21st, in line with the Constitutional Court's 113th year judgment No. 11. The revisions comprise six major changes, such as eliminating the NT$300,000 threshold for installment applications, standardising the estate‑tax calculation for assets gifted to certain relatives within two years of the decedent's death, and confirming that recipients bear tax proportionally, thereby ending the unfair practice where heirs had to pay tax for assets gifted to others and safeguarding tax fairness and property rights.

Previously, assets gifted to a spouse or specified relatives within two years before a decedent’s death were treated as “presumed estate” and added to the total estate for tax purposes, but the tax was entirely shouldered by the heirs, sparking controversy. Under the amendment, Article 6 stipulates that the estate tax on presumed estate will be calculated according to the proportion of the gifted asset to the total estate, with each recipient individually liable for tax; the provision making the executor the taxpayer is removed, and the executor now merely files and pays the tax and may apply for review on behalf of the heirs.

For example, a wealthy father leaves a NT$20 million estate to his only son, but a year before his death he gifts a NT$10 million property to his current wife. If the total estate tax is assessed at NT$3 million, under the old system the son might have to use his inheritance to pay the full NT$3 million. Under the new system, the wife, who received one‑third of the estate (NT$10 million/NT$30 million), becomes a separate taxpayer and must pay NT$1 million in tax, leaving the son responsible for the remaining NT$2 million, thus no longer bearing an unfair burden.

In addition, Article 17‑1 is amended so that when calculating the deduction for the spouse’s residual‑property claim, assets gifted to the spouse within two years of death are treated as the decedent’s existing assets, making the spouse’s rights and deduction amounts more reasonable. In practice, if a husband had gifted his wife NT$10 million, the previous rule would have reduced the spouse’s deduction; the new rule adds that NT$10 million back to the husband’s existing assets, substantially increasing the spouse’s allowable deduction and effectively lightening the estate‑tax load.

The amendments also relax several taxpayer‑friendly measures. Article 30 removes the requirement that the taxable gift amount must exceed NT$300,000 to qualify for installment payment. It also adds that heirs may, by majority vote, use cash held in the estate to pay tax, eliminating the previous deadlock that required unanimous consent to tap estate deposits. However, if a recipient wishes to offset tax with estate assets or pay tax on presumed estate, consent of all heirs is still required.

Article 23 and Article 41 respectively set the start dates for filing and assessment periods in court‑determined estate‑ownership cases, and authorize a taxpayer who provides a mortgage on taxable real‑estate to the tax authority to apply for an approval‑of‑transfer certificate. Article 51 deletes the former penalty‑interest provision, reverting to the unified handling prescribed by the Tax Collection Act.

The Ministry of Finance said it is accelerating the drafting of implementing rules and other subsidiary regulations for the Gift Tax Act, as well as revising filing forms and the online filing system. After the President’s promulgation, a comprehensive public‑education campaign will be launched to guide both taxpayers and tax officials.

items.title: 單月外銷訂單逼近千億美元、明年普發現金1萬元、中信金法說 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Monthly Export Orders Near $100 Billion, Next Year Universal Cash Grant of NT$10,000, CTBC Financial Earnings Call – Weekly Highlights
paras: 經濟部周四(20日)公布7月外銷訂單統計，接單金額達979.4億美元，創歷史單月新高，連18紅；總統賴清德周一(17日)表示，明年將普發現金1萬元，讓全民共享AI紅利；中信金周二(18日)召開法說會，總經理高麗雪指出，上半年淨值增加60%，以下為本周大事回顧：

〈外銷訂單〉連18紅！7月979.4億美元史上新高年增61.9% 資通接單旺到年增近9成

受惠於AI、高效能運算及雲端服務等需求持續強勁，經濟部周四(20日)公布7月外銷訂單統計，單月接單金額高達979.4億美元，較上月增加2.8%，與上年同月相比大幅成長61.9%，不僅創下歷年單月新高，更寫下連續18個月正成長的耀眼佳績。累計1至7月外銷訂單總額已達6,020.3億美元，年增52.5%。

賴清德：明年在歲入歲出平衡下每人普發現金1萬元 讓AI紅利全民共享 

行政院於今(17)日上午第2次向總統賴清德報告明年中央總預算編列情形。賴清德在聽取簡報後表示，台灣憑藉長期的半導體、資通訊等供應鏈優勢，經濟成長率上修，今年可望創下39年來新高，明年總預算將在歲入歲出平衡、實質零舉債下，增列2357億元普發現金予每人1萬元，讓「AI紅利，全民共享」。

〈中信金法說〉ROE下滑是假象！高麗雪：上半年淨值暴增60% 股利配發率6成不變 

中信金控(2891-TW)周二(18日)舉行 2026 年第2季法說會，由總經理高麗雪與財務長徐旻傾說明經營績效與市場展望。面對全球升息疑慮與地緣政治波動，中信金展現強勁資本實力，上半年淨值突破 7000 億元、大增近 60%。高麗雪特別澄清名目 ROE 下滑只是資產重分類下的「帳面數字假象」，強調評估經營成果應著重整體淨值與價值成長，調整後實際 ROE 其實高達 16.56%。至於股利政策，公司將維持 60-65% 的股利配發率，並明確表示會將 OCI 股票處分利益納入盈餘分配考量。

〈上銀展望〉訂單能見度看到明年Q1！卓文恒看好下半年 全年營收雙位數成長無虞 

2026 台灣機器人與智慧自動化展 (TAIROS) 周三 (19日) 登場， 受惠於全球 AI 與半導體設備需求爆發，傳動控制大廠上銀(2049-TW)接單熱絡，訂單能見度直達明(2027)年首季。董事長卓文恒受訪時指出，目前滾珠螺桿交期延長至 6 個月以上，首季也快滿了，工廠正全面加班趕工，預估年底前增加人力 400 名。在亞洲與美國市場強勁拉貨動能帶動下，機器人營收占比已升至 12%，他樂觀看好下半年營運優於上半年，全年營收雙位數成長應沒問題。

〈台北國際自動化展〉新漢營運甩陰霾下半年步步高 AI/人形機器人產品明年放量 

工業電腦廠新漢(8234-TW)董事長林茂昌周三(19)日表示，營運已擺脫陰霾，累計前7月已開始賺錢，目前訂單看起來也還不錯，下半年樂觀，AI智能/人形機器人相關產品最快1-2季後量產，明年會有大幅成長。

〈台北國際自動化展〉和椿：人形機器人是下波成長動能 布局實體AI台灣尚缺電池製造能力 

台北國際自動化工業大展於周三(19日)起一連3日於台北南港展覽館2館開展，自動化暨機器人解決方案廠和椿今(2026)年也盛大參展，展出多品牌、多型態機器人「無人工廠」方案。和椿近年積極打入中小型物流、服務業商機，董事長張以昇表示，公司目前獲利核心主要為機器人自動化設備和零組件，未來成長動能將鎖定人形機器人及Physical AI(實體AI)。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs on Thursday (the 20th) released July export order statistics, showing a total order value of $97.94 billion, a historic monthly high and the 18th consecutive month of growth. President Lai Ching‑de said on Monday (the 17th) that next year a universal cash grant of NT$10,000 will be distributed so that all citizens can share the AI dividend. CTBC Financial held its earnings briefing on Tuesday (the 18th), where General Manager Gao Lixue noted a 60% increase in net assets in the first half of the year. Below is a review of this week’s major events.

Export Orders: 18‑month streak of growth! July’s $97.94 billion hits a record high, up 61.9% year‑on‑year; ICT orders surge nearly 90% year‑on‑year. Benefiting from strong demand for AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services, the Ministry of Economic Affairs reported on Thursday (the 20th) that July’s export orders reached $97.94 billion, a 2.8% rise from the previous month and a 61.9% jump from the same month last year, setting a new monthly record and marking the 18th straight month of growth. Cumulative export orders from January to July total $602.03 billion, up 52.5% year‑on‑year.

Lai Ching‑de: Next year, with a balanced budget, each person will receive a NT$10,000 cash grant to share AI benefits. The Executive Yuan this morning (the 17th) gave President Lai Ching‑de a second briefing on next year’s central budget. After the briefing, Lai said Taiwan’s long‑standing advantages in semiconductor and ICT supply chains will lift the growth rate to a 39‑year high this year, and next year the total budget will be balanced with zero net borrowing while allocating NT$2.357 billion for a universal NT$10,000 cash grant, allowing “AI dividends to be shared by all.”

CTBC Financial Earnings Call: ROE decline is an illusion! Gao Lixue: Net assets surged 60% in the first half, dividend payout ratio stays at 60%. CTBC Financial Holding (2891‑TW) held its Q2 2026 earnings briefing on Tuesday (the 18th), with General Manager Gao Lixue and CFO Xu Min presenting performance and outlook. Despite global rate‑hike concerns and geopolitical volatility, CTBC showed strong capital strength, with first‑half net assets breaking NT$700 billion, up nearly 60%. Gao clarified that the headline ROE drop is merely a “paper‑number illusion” caused by asset reclassification, stressing that overall net‑asset growth should be the focus; the adjusted ROE actually reaches 16.56%. The company will keep a 60‑65% dividend payout ratio and will include gains from OCI stock disposals in profit distribution.

Hiwin Outlook: Order visibility extends to Q1 2027! Chairman Zhuo Wenheng optimistic about H2, confident of double‑digit full‑year revenue growth. The 2026 Taiwan Robotics and Intelligent Automation Expo (TAIROS) opened on Wednesday (the 19th). Riding the global AI and semiconductor‑equipment boom, drive‑control leader Hiwin (2049‑TW) is seeing strong order intake, with visibility reaching the first quarter of 2027. Chairman Zhuo Wenheng said ball‑screw lead times have stretched beyond six months and the first quarter is nearly full, prompting the factory to add 400 workers before year‑end. With robust demand from Asian and U.S. markets, robot revenue now accounts for 12% of sales; he is optimistic that H2 performance will surpass H1 and that full‑year revenue will achieve double‑digit growth.

Xinhang (8234‑TW) at the Taipei International Automation Expo: Operations cleared of gloom, strong H2 outlook, AI/humanoid robot products to scale up next year. Chairman Lin Mao‑chang said on Wednesday (the 19th) that operations have shaken off the gloom, with the first seven months already turning a profit. Orders look solid, and the second half is optimistic. AI‑intelligent and humanoid robot products are expected to enter mass production in 1‑2 quarters, with significant growth anticipated next year.

Hechun at the Taipei International Automation Expo: Humanoid robots are the next growth engine; Taiwan still lacks battery‑manufacturing capacity for physical AI. The Taipei International Automation Industry Exhibition ran for three days starting Wednesday (the 19th) at the Nangang Exhibition Hall. Automation and robotics solutions provider Hechun showcased multi‑brand, multi‑type “factory‑of‑the‑future” robot solutions. Chairman Zhang Yisheng said the company’s current profit core lies in robot automation equipment and components, and future growth will focus on humanoid robots and Physical AI, noting Taiwan’s shortage of battery‑manufacturing capability for such AI applications.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉土洋法人連日掃貨 遠東新帶量突破盤整創5個半月高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Foreign and domestic institutions buying heavily; Far Eastern New breaks out of consolidation with volume, hitting a 5½‑month high
paras: 國際油價走堅，遠東新(1402-TW)近期獲外資及投信連日加碼力挺，股價放量走強突破盤整區，週五最高來到30.6元，創3月2日以來逾5個半月新高，單周則上漲12%。
遠東新近期獲法人加碼，外資連5個交易日買超共4.82萬張，8月以來大買11萬張；投信周五買超1.11萬張，連13個交易日掃貨2.04萬張，在土洋法人同步力挺下，遠東新近期股價走強。
基本面來看，遠東新第二季營收692.72億元，年增15%、稅後純益27.32億元，年增1.8倍，每股純益0.54元；上半年營收1305.64億元，年增5%，稅後純益58.25億元，年增76.3%，每股純益1.15元。
遠東新7月營收233.66億元，月增1.9%、年增20.6%；累計前7月營收1538.8億元，年增7.4%。
遠東新表示，雖然不確定因素仍相當多，但今年整體大環境看來比去年好，高油價對遠東新而言，部分食品包裝用聚酯切片產品已具備轉嫁成本能力，綠色產品在價格同步上漲、但成本未放大下，有助獲利提升。
paras_en: International oil prices remain firm, and Far Eastern New (1402‑TW) has recently received consecutive buying support from foreign investors and investment trusts. The stock surged with volume, breaking out of its consolidation zone and reaching a Friday high of NT$30.6, a new peak not seen since March 2 and the highest in over five and a half months, up 12% for the week.

Far Eastern New has been added to by institutional investors: foreign investors bought a net 48,200 lots over five consecutive trading days and have purchased 110,000 lots since August; investment trusts bought a net 11,100 lots on Friday and have accumulated net purchases of 20,400 lots over 13 trading days. With both foreign and domestic institutions backing the stock, its price has been strengthening recently.

On the fundamentals side, Far Eastern New posted Q2 revenue of NT$69.272 billion, up 15% year‑on‑year, and net profit after tax of NT$2.732 billion, a 1.8‑fold increase year‑on‑year, translating to earnings of NT$0.54 per share. For the first half of the year, revenue reached NT$130.564 billion, up 5% YoY, with net profit after tax of NT$5.825 billion, up 76.3% YoY, or NT$1.15 earnings per share.

In July, Far Eastern New recorded revenue of NT$23.366 billion, up 1.9% month‑over‑month and 20.6% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first seven months was NT$153.88 billion, a 7.4% increase year‑on‑year.

Far Eastern New noted that although many uncertainties remain, the overall macro environment this year appears better than last year. The high oil price has allowed the company’s polyester sheet products used in food packaging to pass on costs, and its green product lines have seen price increases without a corresponding rise in costs, which should help improve profitability.

items.title: Marvell財報8月27日登場！ASIC市場年複合成長率上看43%，Google最高1,200億美元大單成焦點
paras: 2026年08月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)將於8月27日美國東岸時間下午4:45（台北時間8月28日凌晨4:45）公布第2季財報，在AI基礎建設投資持續升溫下，市場焦點將集中在客製化晶片(Custom Silicon)與資料中心光互連業務，尤其Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)最高1,200億美元的長期晶片採購合作，能否逐步轉化為營收與獲利，將是這次財報的重要觀察指標。
BMO Capital Markets近期將Marvell投資評等調升至「優於大盤」(Outperform)，分析師Harsh Kumar看好客製化晶片及資料中心光互連需求。隨著AI模型規模擴大，大型雲端服務商除了持續採購GPU，也積極開發針對特定工作負載設計的ASIC，希望降低運算成本與功耗，帶動客製化AI晶片需求快速升溫。
從市場規模來看，ASIC成長速度更值得注意。SNS Insider預估，全球AI加速器晶片市場規模將由2025年的458億美元，擴大至2035年的7,462億美元，2026年至2035年年複合成長率達32.18%。其中，GPU在2025年約占35%，仍居最大晶片類別，但ASIC預估同期年複合成長率約43%，增速明顯高於整體市場。
大型雲端服務商為提高每瓦運算效能、降低AI推論延遲，正增加自研ASIC比重，而Marvell扮演的角色之一，就是協助客戶將客製化晶片從設計推向量產。換言之，AI晶片市場愈往專用化發展，Marvell可切入的市場空間也愈大。
其中，Marvell與Alphabet的合作最受市場關注。依協議內容，Alphabet至2033會計年度累計晶片採購金額最高可達1,200億美元，並可取得約5,897萬股Marvell認股權證，履約價格為每股206.58美元，相關權利將隨每5億美元投資分批取得。
市場估計，若認股權證全數執行，現有股東可能面臨約6%至7%的潛在稀釋，但對Marvell而言，換來的是更長期的AI晶片訂單能見度。隨著Google等大型雲端服務商加快自研AI晶片，Marvell能否複製相關合作模式、爭取更多大型客戶，也將影響後續成長空間。
營運方面，Marvell第1季營收達24.2億美元，年增27.6%；公司預估第2季調整後每股盈餘介於0.88美元至0.98美元。市場除了關注財報是否達標，也將緊盯Google等雲端客戶專案進度，以及AI業務快速放量後，毛利率能否同步改善。
法人資金也提前布局。BlackRock持有Marvell股數提高逾三分之一至8,564萬股，挪威央行新建立約8.95億美元部位，Bank of New York Mellon持股則增加153.3%。在ASIC成長速度高於整體AI加速器市場之際，Marvell這次財報的關鍵，已不只是單季數字，而是客製化AI晶片能否成為下一階段主要成長引擎。
